title: Design of fences.
officialText:
Fence installations shall be designed by a registered design professional. The effect of wind on the
fence shall be considered in the design in accordance with Chapter 16.
Exceptions:
1. Fences installed in connection with the construction or demolition of a one-, two-, or three-family building.
2. Fences that conform to a standard design approved by the commissioner provided the fence is installed at the site
in accordance with the standard design.
